title: nabalus crepidineus
intro: Nabalus crepidineus, commonly known as American bugleweed or American water bugle, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. Nabalus crepidineus contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may have antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
